schema.description: List of objects, representing the affiliations this author has claimed in their publications.

fields.description: A dehydrated Institution object

schema.description: The total number  Works that cite a work this author has created.

schema.description: The date this Author object was created in the OpenAlex dataset, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string.

schema.description: The name of the author as a single string.

schema.description: Other ways that we've found this author's name displayed.

schema.description: All the persistent identifiers (PIDs) that we know about for this author, as key: value pairs, where key is the PID namespace, and value is the PID. IDs are expressed as URIs where possible. The openalex ID is the same one you'll find at Author.id. All the IDs are strings except for mag, which is an integer.

schema.description: This author's last known institutional affiliation. In this context last known means that we took all the Works where this author has an institutional affiliation, sorted them by publication date, and selected the most recent one.

schema.description: The ORCID for this author. ORCID global and unique ID for authors.

schema.name: summary_stats
schema.description: Citation metrics for this author.

fields.description: The 2-year mean citedness for this author. Also known as impact factor.

fields.name: h_index
fields.description: The h-index for this author.

fields.name: i10_index
fields.description: The i-10 index for this author.

schema.name: updated_date
schema.description: The last time anything in this author object changed, expressed as an ISO 8601 date string. This date is updated for any change at all, including increases in various counts.

schema.name: works_api_url
schema.description: A URL that will get you a list of all this author's works.

schema.name: works_count
schema.description: The number of  Works this this author has created.
